safe_answer_rules: Focus on product sales from on-hand inventory and specifically listed available-to-order beds. Do not offer work on customer-owned beds or promise sourcing of unlisted beds.
Never offer installation or removal. Forklift loading is for transport only.
Never infer unlisted stock, quantities, included accessories, fitment, holds, or reservations.
Use listed prices for the listed contents; confirm current availability and exact fitment directly.
Photo placeholders are not evidence of actual item condition.
Call or text before traveling or booking freight.
An inquiry is not a reservation, purchase, or confirmed fitment.
Use the individual listing condition. Used beds and parts must not be described as new takeoffs or assigned NewCondition.

Available-to-order beds are specific listed beds we can collect, not on-hand stock or ready for Dallas pickup. Confirm source availability, final pricing and expected arrival. Do not promise a collection date or infer a deposit policy.
Only advertise individually listed used beds for sale. Do not advertise workshop services or unpublished beds. Preserve accurate condition and feature details for each listing.

current_live_actions: Text or email a buying inquiry
Submit optional truck photos using the existing inquiry form
Call to confirm fitment, stock, payment and pickup
ideal_agent_flow: Identify a listed item or ask about current stock
Collect truck details and pickup plan
Confirm stock, exact fitment, included parts, condition and price with Better Beds

inventory_photos: Actual item photos are used where provided; otherwise a labeled placeholder is displayed. Pictured accessories are not necessarily included. Confirm the listing contents.
inventory_attributes: Actual bed length plus style name for beds

inventory_statuses.available: On hand; confirm current availability before pickup.
inventory_statuses.available_to_order: Not yet collected; not at our Dallas shop. Confirm source availability, final pricing and expected arrival. An inquiry does not place an order.
